name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, and ZAR by carry-to-vol ratio over the last 2 years. Carry = EM interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds rate (monthly FRED, ffilled). Vol = 63-day realized FX volatility. FX pairs inverted so positive = EM currency appreciation vs USD. Cross-sectional ranking by carry-to-vol, plus 21-day forward return analysis by tercile (top vs bottom). Event markers fire when a currency enters the top-tercile carry-to-vol rank.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# =============================================================================
# Carry = EM interbank rate - USD Fed Funds rate (monthly FRED, ffilled daily)
# Vol   = 63-day realized FX volatility on inverted FX close (annualized)
# FX convention: invert USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR so positive return = EM appreciation
# Cross-sectional rank by carry-to-vol; 21-day forward return by tercile
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# FX DATA — load USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR and invert to EM-appreciation convention
# =============================================================================

brl_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
mxn_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDMXN')()
zar_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDZAR')()

# Invert: 1/USDBRL = BRLUSD. Rising = BRL strengthening vs USD.
brl_close = 1.0 / brl_raw.c
mxn_close = 1.0 / mxn_raw.c
zar_close = 1.0 / zar_raw.c

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# INTEREST RATES — monthly FRED series, ffilled to daily
# Brazil: immediate interbank rate (IRSTCI01BRM156N)
# Mexico: immediate interbank rate (IRSTCI01MXM156N)
# South Africa: 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01ZAM156N)
# USD: Fed Funds effective rate daily (DFF)
# =============================================================================

brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01MXM156N')()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()

brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY — EM rate minus USD rate (percentage points, e.g. 10.5 = 10.5pp)
# =============================================================================

brl_carry = brl_rate - usd_rate
mxn_carry = mxn_rate - usd_rate
zar_carry = zar_rate - usd_rate

# =============================================================================
# REALIZED VOLATILITY — 63-day rolling on inverted FX close (price levels)
# volatility() expects price levels; outputs annualized decimal vol (e.g. 0.12 = 12%)
# Multiply by 100 to convert to percentage points for carry-to-vol ratio
# (carry is in pp, vol in pp → ratio is dimensionless)
# =============================================================================

brl_vol_dec = volatility(period=63)(brl_close)
mxn_vol_dec = volatility(period=63)(mxn_close)
zar_vol_dec = volatility(period=63)(zar_close)

# Convert annualized vol from decimal to percentage points (matches carry units)
brl_vol = brl_vol_dec * 100.0
mxn_vol = mxn_vol_dec * 100.0
zar_vol = zar_vol_dec * 100.0

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO — carry (pp) / vol (pp) = dimensionless risk-adjusted carry
# Guard: only compute when vol > 0 and carry is valid
# =============================================================================

brl_ctv = where(is_valid(brl_vol) and brl_vol > 0.0 and is_valid(brl_carry), brl_carry / brl_vol)
mxn_ctv = where(is_valid(mxn_vol) and mxn_vol > 0.0 and is_valid(mxn_carry), mxn_carry / mxn_vol)
zar_ctv = where(is_valid(zar_vol) and zar_vol > 0.0 and is_valid(zar_carry), zar_carry / zar_vol)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK — percentile rank across the 3 currencies at each bar
# cs_rank_quantile: 0.0 = lowest carry-to-vol, 1.0 = highest
# =============================================================================

brl_rank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=True)(brl_ctv)
mxn_rank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=True)(mxn_ctv)
zar_rank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=True)(zar_ctv)

# Top tercile = rank >= 0.67 (top 1/3 of the 3-currency universe)
brl_top = is_valid(brl_rank) and brl_rank >= 0.67
mxn_top = is_valid(mxn_rank) and mxn_rank >= 0.67
zar_top = is_valid(zar_rank) and zar_rank >= 0.67

# Bottom tercile = rank <= 0.33
brl_bot = is_valid(brl_rank) and brl_rank <= 0.33
mxn_bot = is_valid(mxn_rank) and mxn_rank <= 0.33
zar_bot = is_valid(zar_rank) and zar_rank <= 0.33

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS — 21-day ahead FX return (EM appreciation convention)
# forward_returns on price levels: (close[t+21] - close[t]) / close[t]
# =============================================================================

brl_fwd21 = forward_returns(period=21)(brl_close)
mxn_fwd21 = forward_returns(period=21)(mxn_close)
zar_fwd21 = forward_returns(period=21)(zar_close)

# Filter forward returns by tercile membership
brl_fwd_top = where(brl_top, brl_fwd21)
mxn_fwd_top = where(mxn_top, mxn_fwd21)
zar_fwd_top = where(zar_top, zar_fwd21)

brl_fwd_bot = where(brl_bot, brl_fwd21)
mxn_fwd_bot = where(mxn_bot, mxn_fwd21)
zar_fwd_bot = where(zar_bot, zar_fwd21)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Carry-to-Vol ratio over time — all 3 currencies on one chart
# Context: "Where is each currency's risk-adjusted carry right now?"
# =============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio Over Time (BRL, MXN, ZAR)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Realized Vol (ratio)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Carry = Vol', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    colors=[Color.Green, Color.Orange, Color.Blue],
    order=0
)(bar_ts, brl_ctv, mxn_ctv, zar_ctv)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Current carry-to-vol snapshot — ranked bar chart
# Punchline: "Which currency has the best risk-adjusted carry right now?"
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ratio (Last Value)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    sort_by_value='Descending',
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Carry / Realized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Carry = Vol', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(brl_ctv, mxn_ctv, zar_ctv)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3: Forward return by tercile — does top carry-to-vol predict returns?
# Punchline: "Does the top-ranked currency outperform over the next 21 days?"
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='21-Day Forward FX Return: Top vs Bottom Carry-to-Vol Tercile',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Mean 21-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(brl_fwd_top, mxn_fwd_top, zar_fwd_top, brl_fwd_bot, mxn_fwd_bot, zar_fwd_bot)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Carry, vol, carry-to-vol, and forward return stats per currency
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='EM Carry-to-Vol Summary (Last Values + Mean 21D Fwd Return)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=3
)(brl_carry, mxn_carry, zar_carry, brl_vol, mxn_vol, zar_vol, brl_ctv, mxn_ctv, zar_ctv)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Top-tercile carry-to-vol entries per currency
# Fires when a currency moves into the top-tercile rank
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BRL Top Carry-to-Vol Tercile',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='BRL Carry-to-Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='BRL Carry (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='BRL Realized Vol (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='CS Rank (0-1)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(brl_top, brl_ctv, brl_carry, brl_vol, brl_rank)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='MXN Top Carry-to-Vol Tercile',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='MXN Carry-to-Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='MXN Carry (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='MXN Realized Vol (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='CS Rank (0-1)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(mxn_top, mxn_ctv, mxn_carry, mxn_vol, mxn_rank)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ZAR Top Carry-to-Vol Tercile',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='ZAR Carry-to-Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='ZAR Carry (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='ZAR Realized Vol (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='CS Rank (0-1)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(zar_top, zar_ctv, zar_carry, zar_vol, zar_rank)
